say:4:1826064003:1.text: Never before have I endured such a hurried and exhausting sleep... I suppose I have you two to thank for that, Merlin and Bedivere.
say:4:1826064003:1.source_cn: 余第一次体验到这样仓促又令人疲惫的睡眠……这可真是多亏...
say:4:1826064003:1.male: Never before have I endured such a hurried and exhausting sleep... I suppose I have you two to thank for that, Merlin and Bedivere.
say:4:1826064003:1.female: Never before have I endured such a hurried and exhausting sleep... I suppose I have you two to thank for that, Merlin and Bedivere.

choice_prompt:5:1826064003.text: Never before have I endured such a hurried and exhausting sleep... I suppose I have you two to thank for that, Merlin and Bedivere.
choice_prompt:5:1826064003.source_cn: 余第一次体验到这样仓促又令人疲惫的睡眠……这可真是多亏了你们呀，梅林，贝狄威尔。
choice_prompt:5:1826064003.male: Never before have I endured such a hurried and exhausting sleep... I suppose I have you two to thank for that, Merlin and Bedivere.
choice_prompt:5:1826064003.female: Never before have I endured such a hurried and exhausting sleep... I suppose I have you two to thank for that, Merlin and Bedivere.

say:6:1826064004:1.text: Oh, Merlin. I always took you for someone with a bigger heart.
say:6:1826064004:1.source_cn: 伟大的梅林，你何时变得如此小气了？
say:6:1826064004:1.male: Oh, Merlin. I always took you for someone with a bigger heart.
say:6:1826064004:1.female: Oh, Merlin. I always took you for someone with a bigger heart.

say:7:1826064007:1.text: Anyway, I owe you both my thanks. Especially you, Bedivere. I must say, it's quite a surprise to see you here in your true form.
say:7:1826064007:1.source_cn: 总之，余还是要向两位道一声谢。尤其是贝狄威尔，没想到你...

say:8:1826064008:1.text: The circumstances left me no choice. You're in charge of all Arcane Council affairs in Bantus, and we can't afford to lose control of Novaris.
say:8:1826064008:1.source_cn: 情况危急，我不得不来。魔法师协会在班题斯的种种部署都由...

say:9:1826064009:1.text: It now falls upon you to <style="highlight">drive those Bantus forces out</style>.

say:10:1826064010:1.text: Child's play. Don't look so grim, you two great mages.
say:10:1826064010:1.source_cn: 小事一桩。别板着脸嘛，两位大魔法师。
say:10:1826064010:1.male: Child's play. Don't look so grim, you two great mages.
say:10:1826064010:1.female: Child's play. Don't look so grim, you two great mages.

choice_prompt:11:1826064010.text: Child's play. Don't look so grim, you two great mages.
choice_prompt:11:1826064010.source_cn: 小事一桩。别板着脸嘛，两位大魔法师。
choice_prompt:11:1826064010.male: Child's play. Don't look so grim, you two great mages.
choice_prompt:11:1826064010.female: Child's play. Don't look so grim, you two great mages.

say:12:1826064012:1.text: Don't worry about me. <style="highlight">Do you know why the previous Bedivere chose me for this position? Because I could hold my own against Bantus, even without an army at my back</style>.
say:12:1826064012:1.source_cn: 不用为余之力量担忧。想当初，<style=highli...

say:13:1826064013:1.text: Ah, my apologies. It seems you've forgotten what I'm capable of. Very well, you may come with me and witness for yourself.
say:13:1826064013:1.source_cn: 看在你失忆的份上，余不介意你一同前去，旁观见证。
say:13:1826064013:1.male: Ah, my apologies. It seems you've forgotten what I'm capable of. Very well, you may come with me and witness for yourself.
say:13:1826064013:1.female: Ah, my apologies. It seems you've forgotten what I'm capable of. Very well, you may come with me and witness for yourself.

say:14:1826064014:1.text: Bedivere, would you like to join us?
say:14:1826064014:1.source_cn: 还有贝狄威尔。你意下如何？

say:15:1826064015:1.text: Thank you for your kind offer, but I cannot risk being recognized in Novaris, not with who I am.
say:15:1826064015:1.source_cn: 多谢你的好意，但以我的对外身份，更不适合出现在诺珐斯。

say:17:1826064017:1.text: Let us be off, Merlin. Those Bantus buffoons must be waiting with bated breath for my arrival.
say:17:1826064017:1.source_cn: 那便出发吧，梅林。班题斯那些不知死活的家伙，现在可是翘...
say:17:1826064017:1.male: Let us be off, Merlin. Those Bantus buffoons must be waiting with bated breath for my arrival.
say:17:1826064017:1.female: Let us be off, Merlin. Those Bantus buffoons must be waiting with bated breath for my arrival.

choice:11:0:1.text: Can you handle it on your own?
choice:11:0:1.male: Can you handle it on your own?
choice:11:0:1.female: Can you handle it on your own?

say:19:1826064011:1.text: That wouldn't be wise. If you show yourself, Bantus will discover your true identity.
say:19:1826064011:1.source_cn: 不必。你若出现，班题斯势必会知晓你的身份。

choice:5:0:1.text: Not even a word of thanks? You're breaking my heart!
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 你一点都不感激吗？太伤我心了
choice:5:0:1.male: Not even a word of thanks? You're breaking my heart!
choice:5:0:1.female: Not even a word of thanks? You're breaking my heart!

choice:5:1:2.text: We did it for you and Novaris!
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 这都是为了你和诺珐斯！
choice:5:1:2.male: We did it for you and Novaris!
choice:5:1:2.female: We did it for you and Novaris!

say:21:1826064006:1.text: I know you care about me more than you let on, Merlin.
say:21:1826064006:1.source_cn: 你现在也学会口是心非了呢，梅林。
say:21:1826064006:1.male: I know you care about me more than you let on, Merlin.
say:21:1826064006:1.female: I know you care about me more than you let on, Merlin.

choice:5:2:3.text: I wouldn't have bothered if Eryndor hadn't come to me.
choice:5:2:3.source_cn: 如果埃德加没找我，我才懒得管你
choice:5:2:3.male: I wouldn't have bothered if Eryndor hadn't come to me.
choice:5:2:3.female: I wouldn't have bothered if Eryndor hadn't come to me.
